purpose: A detached middle cache reached below an active outer link raises its real null-key Error; explicit next then consumes the scalar return and resumes both source tails while a retained original child owns its old object cache.

<?php
class NestedRetainedCache16 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
function nestedRetainedChild16() { echo "C|"; yield new NestedRetainedCache16(); echo "L|"; return 23; }
function nestedRetainedMiddle16() { try { echo "H|"; $result = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "R|", $result, "|"; yield 13; return 29; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function nestedRetainedOuter16() { try { echo "G|"; $result = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "OR|", $result, "|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function nestedRetainedTarget16($value) { echo "BAD|"; }
$child = nestedRetainedChild16(); $middle = nestedRetainedMiddle16(); $outer = nestedRetainedOuter16();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next();
echo "V|", $middle->current() instanceof NestedRetainedCache16 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|";
try { nestedRetainedTarget16(...$outer); } catch (Error $caught) { echo "T|", $caught->getLine(), "|", $caught->getTrace() === [] ? "NOFRAME|" : "BADTRACE|"; }
echo "N|"; $outer->next(); echo "D|", $outer->current(), "|K|", $outer->key(), "|";
$outer->next(); unset($outer, $middle); echo "M|"; unset($child); echo "E";
